SENT ON BEHALF OF STEVE VENTURATOS

You recently received a memo from Brenda Herod laying out the Organizational 
changes that would effect the Texas Region, this follow up is an effort to 
breakdown our Risk organization.   With new members being added to the team 
many responsibilities will be changing, however controls and other measures 
already in place will ensure a smooth transition.  Following is the schedule 
of responsibilities effective May 1st and June 1st, as the transition will 
take a month. 

   Effective May 1     Effective June 1

FT Texas  O'Neal Winfree      Ami Chokshi
